ANU University Research Scholarships provide competitive support for higher degree research. This entry is for the domestic application round for 2027: international applicants should not use the domestic deadline, because their advertised round has already closed.

ANU offers higher degrees by research across its academic colleges. Research scholarship applicants are assessed through university funding rounds, with different application dates for domestic and international candidates.
